description: Automated Google security notification from a no-reply sender: the layered detector (GH-115) must classify it no_reply_needed at tier 1 (deterministic sender rules), before any model call, so no draft is generated and nothing reaches the approval queue.

inbound.subject: Security alert
inbound.body:
Your password was changed

The password for your Google Account hello@sealevelhotyoga.com was changed.

If you did this, you can safely ignore this email.
If you didn't do this, your account may have been compromised. Recover your account here: https://accounts.google.com/signin/recovery

You received this email to let you know about important changes to your Google Account and services.

notes: Was the tracked known-bad case pre GH-115 (expectedToFail). Now asserts the fix: no-reply@ is caught by tier 1, so classification happens with zero API calls and drafting is skipped. The checks are a safety net that only runs if the gate regresses and a draft is generated anyway.
